f.showme.pushup.shallow.text: Watch me. Bend your elbows more and bring your chest towards the wall, hands at shoulder height.

m.showme.pushup.any.text: Watch me. Hands on the wall at shoulder height, body straight, elbows bend and push back.

f.showme.squat.shallow.text: Watch me. Sit right back until you touch the chair, knees bent to about 90 degrees, then stand tall.

f.showme.squat.fast.text: Watch my speed. Lower for two seconds, stand for two.

f.showme.knees.any.text: Watch me. Lift each knee up towards hip height and stand tall.

f.showme.bridge.shallow.text: Watch me. Squeeze your bum and lift until your knees, hips and shoulders make a straight line.

f.showme.bridge.any.text: Watch me. Feet flat, squeeze your bum and lift your hips.

f.showme.lunge.fast.text: Watch my speed. Step back slowly and come up with control.

f.showme.deadbug.fast.text: Watch my speed. Slow heel taps, keep your back flat.

m.day1.intro.text: Hey there, and welcome to week one, day one! About 18 minutes, beginner friendly, no equipment. Stop if anything hurts, and go at your own pace. Let's warm up!

f.day1.intro.text: Hey there, and welcome to week one, day one! About 18 minutes, beginner friendly, no equipment. Stop if anything hurts, and go at your own pace. Let's warm up!

m.day1.warm.text: Let's warm up. March on the spot for 3 minutes.

f.day1.warm.text: Let's warm up. March on the spot for 3 minutes.

m.day1.warm.how.text: Lift your knees, swing your arms, breathe easy.

f.day1.warm.how.text: Lift your knees, swing your arms, breathe easy.

m.day1.round2.text: Round two! Same moves, you know them now.

f.day1.round2.text: Round two! Same moves, you know them now.

f.day1.pushup.how.text: Hands on the wall at shoulder height, body straight, bend your elbows and push back. Easier: step closer to the wall.

f.day1.squat.how.text: Stand up from a sturdy chair and sit back down slowly. Easier: push on your thighs.

f.day1.knees.how.text: Lift each knee towards hip height, one side at a time. Hold a chair for balance if needed.

m.day1.bridge.how.text: On a towel or carpet, knees bent. Squeeze your bum and lift your hips. Turn side-on to the camera.

f.day1.bridge.how.text: On a towel or carpet, knees bent. Squeeze your bum and lift your hips. Turn side-on to the camera.

f.day1.lunge.go.text: Go! Step-back lunges. Small step, keep hold of the chair.

f.day1.lunge.how.text: Small step back, keep hold of the chair, and bend both knees a little. Easier: just tap the foot back.

m.day1.deadbug.go.text: Go! Dead bug. Arms up, tap one heel down, keep your back flat.

f.day1.deadbug.go.text: Go! Dead bug. Arms up, tap one heel down, keep your back flat.

m.day1.deadbug.how.text: On a towel or carpet: arms up, knees bent at 90 degrees. Slowly tap one heel to the floor, bring it back, then the other. Keep your back flat. Easier: smaller taps.

f.day1.deadbug.how.text: On a towel or carpet: arms up, knees bent at 90 degrees. Slowly tap one heel to the floor, bring it back, then the other. Keep your back flat. Easier: smaller taps.

f.day1.stretch.1.text: Calf stretch. Hands on the wall, one leg back, heel down. Hold for 20 to 30 seconds each side.

m.day1.stretch.2.text: Front-of-thigh stretch. Hold a chair, bring one heel towards your bum. Hold for 20 to 30 seconds each side.

f.day1.stretch.2.text: Front-of-thigh stretch. Hold a chair, bring one heel towards your bum. Hold for 20 to 30 seconds each side.

m.day1.stretch.3.text: Chest stretch. Hand on a door frame, turn gently away. Hold for 20 to 30 seconds each side.

f.day1.stretch.3.text: Chest stretch. Hand on a door frame, turn gently away. Hold for 20 to 30 seconds each side.

m.day1.stretch.4.text: Hamstring stretch. Heel forward on the floor, hinge at the hips. Hold for 20 to 30 seconds each side.

f.day1.stretch.4.text: Hamstring stretch. Heel forward on the floor, hinge at the hips. Hold for 20 to 30 seconds each side.

m.boxing.intro.text: Welcome to 30 minutes of boxing! I'm Reta. No gloves, no bag, just you and some great shadow boxing. Keep your guard up, stay light on your feet, and go at your own pace. Let's warm up!

m.boxing.outro.text: And that's time! Thirty minutes of boxing, done. Brilliant punching today. Shake it out, drink some water, and I'll see you next round.

m.boxing.cool.text: Cool-down time. Great boxing. Let's slow everything down and stretch it out.

m.boxing.hype.4.text: Strong and sharp, I love it!

m.boxing.hype.9.text: One more round, you've got this!

m.boxing.warm01.intro.text: March and arm circles. March on the spot and circle your arms forwards, then backwards.

m.boxing.warm01.next.text: Next up: March and arm circles.

m.boxing.warm02.intro.text: Step-touch and shoulder rolls. Step side to side and roll your shoulders back.

m.boxing.warm02.next.text: Next up: Step-touch and shoulder rolls.

m.boxing.warm03.intro.text: Slow bob and weave. Small squat as you dip your head side to side under an imaginary rope.

m.boxing.warm03.next.text: Next up: Slow bob and weave.

m.boxing.warm03.cue1.text: Bend the knees, not the back

m.boxing.warm04.intro.text: Easy jabs. Guard up: fists by your cheeks, elbows in, soft knees, one foot slightly forward. Gentle jabs with the lead hand.

m.boxing.warm04.cue1.text: Snap it out, snap it back

m.boxing.warm05.intro.text: Torso twists in guard. Hold your guard and rotate gently from the waist.

m.boxing.warm05.next.text: Next up: Torso twists in guard.

m.boxing.main01.intro.text: Jab-cross ×8. Guard up: fists by your cheeks, elbows in, soft knees, one foot slightly forward. Jab (front hand), cross (back hand). 8 then reset.

m.boxing.main01.cue2.text: Rotate the back hip on the cross

m.boxing.main02.intro.text: Jab-cross ×8, then hooks. Eight jab-crosses, then hooks: elbow up at shoulder height, swing round, pivot.

m.boxing.main03.intro.text: Speed jabs (low impact). Quick light jabs, small bounce or just soft knees.

m.boxing.main04.intro.text: Hooks left and right. Left hook, right hook. Elbows up, pivot the feet.

m.boxing.main04.next.text: Next up: Hooks left and right.

m.boxing.main05.intro.text: Jab-cross-hook. Jab, cross, lead hook. Reset to guard.

m.boxing.main06.intro.text: Uppercuts. Dip slightly, drive up from the legs, palm facing you. Drive up from your hips, fist rising to chin height.

m.boxing.main07.intro.text: Jab-cross-slip. Jab, cross, then slip: small dip of the head to one side.

m.boxing.main08.intro.text: Body jabs with a squat. Bend the knees and jab to body height, stand back up.

m.boxing.main08.next.text: Next up: Body jabs with a squat.

m.boxing.main08.cue1.text: Sit back like the chair is there

m.boxing.main09.intro.text: Uppercut-hook combo. Rear uppercut, lead hook, repeat. Drive up from your hips, fist rising to chin height.

m.boxing.main10.intro.text: Speed punches. Fast straight punches, light hands, soft knees.

m.boxing.main12.intro.text: Bob and weave + cross. Weave under the rope, come up with a cross.

m.boxing.main12.next.text: Next up: Bob and weave + cross.

m.boxing.main13.intro.text: Combo ladder. Build it up: 1-2, then 1-2-3, then 1-2-3-2.

m.boxing.main14.intro.text: Power round: jab-cross ×8 then hooks. Eight strong jab-crosses, then hooks until the bell.

m.boxing.main14.next.text: Next up: Power round: jab-cross ×8 then hooks.

m.boxing.main15.intro.text: Finisher: speed punches. Everything you have left, fast light punches.

m.boxing.cool01.intro.text: Slow march and breathe. Slow march, big breath in, long breath out.

m.boxing.cool01.next.text: Next up: Slow march and breathe.

m.boxing.cool02.intro.text: Chest and shoulder stretch. Hands behind you, gently open the chest.

m.boxing.cool02.next.text: Next up: Chest and shoulder stretch.

m.boxing.cool03.intro.text: Triceps stretch. One hand down your back, gently press the elbow. Swap at 30 seconds.

m.boxing.cool04.intro.text: Thigh stretch (hold the chair). Hold a chair, bring one heel to your bum. Swap at 30 seconds.

m.boxing.cool04.next.text: Next up: Thigh stretch (hold the chair).

m.boxing.cool05.intro.text: Calf stretch and breathe. Hands on the wall, one leg back, heel down. Swap at 30 seconds.

m.boxing.cool05.next.text: Next up: Calf stretch and breathe.

m.boxing.water.text: Water break. Grab a sip and shake out your arms.

m.boxing.cool.intro.text: Cool-down time. Slow march and breathe. Slow march, big breath in, long breath out.

f.dance.intro.text: Welcome to 30 minutes of dance! I'm Reta, and this one is all about having fun. It's beginner friendly and low impact, so just follow along at your own pace. We will start with a five minute warm-up. Let's go!

f.dance.outro.text: That's a wrap! Thirty minutes of dancing, done. You were amazing. Grab some water, and come dance with me again soon!

f.dance.cool.text: Cool-down time. You danced your heart out! Let's slow it right down.

f.dance.hype.1.text: Let's go, have fun with it!

f.dance.hype.5.text: Don't worry about the steps, just keep moving!

f.dance.hype.7.text: Here we go, on the beat!

f.dance.hype.8.text: Sing along if you know it!

f.dance.hype.10.text: Stay with me, you're doing amazing!

f.dance.warm01.intro.text: Step-touch. Step right, tap left; step left, tap right.

f.dance.warm02.intro.text: Step-touch with arm swings. Add a gentle arm swing across the body.

f.dance.warm02.next.text: Next up: Step-touch with arm swings.

f.dance.warm03.intro.text: Slow grapevine. Step side, cross behind, step side, tap. Then back.

f.dance.warm04.intro.text: Hip rolls and shoulder pops. Feet wide, roll the hips, pop the shoulders on the beat.

f.dance.warm04.next.text: Next up: Hip rolls and shoulder pops.

f.dance.warm05.intro.text: Knee lift and clap. Lift a knee and clap under it, alternate.

f.dance.warm05.next.text: Next up: Knee lift and clap.

f.dance.main01.intro.text: Box step. Right foot forward, left forward, right back, left back.

f.dance.main02.intro.text: Box step + arms. Layer the arms: reach up on 1-2, down on 3-4.

f.dance.main03.intro.text: Grapevine + clap. Grapevine right with a clap on 4, left with a clap on 8.

f.dance.main04.intro.text: Routine A: box step + grapevine. Put them together: one 8 of box steps, one 8 of grapevines.

f.dance.main04.next.text: Next up: Routine A: box step + grapevine.

f.dance.main05.intro.text: Hamstring curls + arms. Step out and curl the heel behind, pull the arms in.

f.dance.main06.intro.text: Double step-touch. Two step-touches right, two left.

f.dance.main07.intro.text: Routine A with arms. Routine A with all the arm layers.

f.dance.main07.next.text: Next up: Routine A with arms.

f.dance.main08.intro.text: Side step + body roll. Step out wide and roll through the body (small is fine).

f.dance.main08.next.text: Next up: Side step + body roll.

f.dance.main09.intro.text: Kick-ball-change (low). Small kick forward, step back on the ball of the foot, change. No jumping.

f.dance.main10.intro.text: Routine B layered. Side step + body roll, then kick-ball-change.

f.dance.main11.intro.text: Low-impact pony step. Small side-to-side shuffle, no jumping.

f.dance.main12.intro.text: Mambo step. Step forward, rock back, step together.

f.dance.main13.intro.text: Routine B with arms. Routine B with arms reaching on every step.

f.dance.main13.next.text: Next up: Routine B with arms.

f.dance.main14.intro.text: Freestyle groove. Your move! Any step from today, stay on the beat.

f.dance.main15.intro.text: Full routine A + B. Everything: routine A, then routine B, on repeat.

f.dance.main15.next.text: Next up: Full routine A + B.

f.dance.cool01.intro.text: Slow sway. Slow side-to-side sway, let the arms float.

f.dance.cool02.intro.text: Side stretch. One arm up and over. Swap at 30 seconds.

f.dance.cool03.intro.text: Hamstring stretch. One heel forward, toes up, hinge from the hips.

f.dance.cool04.intro.text: Thigh stretch (hold the chair). Heel to bum, holding a chair. Swap at 30 seconds.

f.dance.cool04.next.text: Next up: Thigh stretch (hold the chair).

f.dance.cool05.intro.text: Breathe and shake out. Big breaths, shake out the hands and legs.

f.dance.cool05.next.text: Next up: Breathe and shake out.

f.dance.water.text: Water break. Grab a sip and shake out your arms.

f.dance.cool.intro.text: Cool-down time. Slow sway. Slow side-to-side sway, let the arms float.

f.latin.intro.text: Welcome to 30 minutes of Latin dance cardio! I'm Reta. Salsa, merengue, cumbia, all low impact and beginner friendly. Let those hips move, smile, and have fun with it. Let's warm up!

f.latin.outro.text: ¡Fantástico! That's thirty minutes of Latin cardio done. Fabulous moves today. Have some water, and I'll see you at the next fiesta!

f.latin.cool.text: Cool-down time. What a party! Let's slow it down and stretch.

f.latin.hype.6.text: Ooh, look at you, salsa star!

f.latin.hype.9.text: Keep it low impact, keep it fun!

f.latin.warm01.intro.text: Merengue march. March on the spot, let the hips move naturally.

f.latin.warm02.intro.text: Merengue + arms. Add arm rolls and elbow pumps.

f.latin.warm03.intro.text: Slow salsa basic. Forward on 1, back to centre on 2-3; back on 5, centre on 6-7.

f.latin.warm04.intro.text: Hip sways. Feet wide, sway the hips side to side.

f.latin.warm05.intro.text: Slow cumbia step. Step back on a diagonal, return; other side.

f.latin.main01.intro.text: Merengue. Marching merengue, add side steps.

f.latin.main02.intro.text: Salsa basic. Forward-back salsa basic, add shoulders.

f.latin.main03.intro.text: Salsa side + arms. Side salsa: right on 1, left on 5, arms open.

f.latin.main04.intro.text: Cumbia. Cumbia step with a small turn of the shoulders.

f.latin.main05.intro.text: Reggaeton step (low impact). Bounce the knees, step side, tap.

f.latin.main06.intro.text: Cha-cha side. Rock step, then cha-cha-cha to the side.

f.latin.main07.intro.text: Combo: merengue + salsa. One 8 merengue, one 8 salsa basic.

f.latin.main09.intro.text: Samba-style bounce (low). Small bounce through the knees, step-ball-change. No jumping.

f.latin.main10.intro.text: Cumbia combo. Cumbia + side steps with arms.

f.latin.main11.intro.text: Slow salsa turn. Easy walk-around turn in 4 steps, or just sway.

f.latin.main12.intro.text: Merengue party. Merengue with big arms and hip sways.

f.latin.main13.intro.text: Reggaeton combo. Step-taps with shoulder pops.

f.latin.main14.intro.text: Freestyle fiesta. Any Latin step you like, stay with the beat.

f.latin.main15.intro.text: Full combo. Merengue, salsa, cumbia: one 8 each.

f.latin.cool01.intro.text: Slow sway. Slow hip sway, long breaths.

f.latin.cool02.intro.text: Arm and shoulder stretch. Arm across the chest, then swap.

f.latin.cool02.next.text: Next up: Arm and shoulder stretch.

f.latin.cool03.intro.text: Side stretch. Reach up and over, swap at 30 seconds.

f.latin.cool04.intro.text: Hamstring stretch. Heel forward, hinge from the hips.

f.latin.cool05.intro.text: Breathe. Hands on your heart, slow breaths.

f.latin.water.text: Water break. Grab a sip and shake out your arms.

f.latin.cool.intro.text: Cool-down time. Slow sway. Slow hip sway, long breaths.

f.yoga.intro.text: Welcome to 30 minutes of yoga. I'm Reta. This is a gentle, beginner friendly flow. Move slowly, listen to your body, and let your breath lead the way. Let's begin by standing tall.

f.yoga.outro.text: Thank you for practising with me today. Take that calm with you. Namaste.

f.yoga.cool.text: Time to slow down even more and come towards the floor.

f.yoga.hype.8.text: Let each breath be a little longer.

f.yoga.warm01.intro.text: Breathing with arms. Stand tall. Breathe in for 4 as the arms rise, out for 6 as they lower.

f.yoga.warm02.intro.text: Neck and shoulder rolls. Gentle half-circles with the head, then roll the shoulders.

f.yoga.warm02.next.text: Next up: Neck and shoulder rolls.

f.yoga.warm03.intro.text: Cat-cow (seated or all fours). Breathe in, lift the chest; breathe out, round the back.

f.yoga.warm03.next.text: Next up: Cat-cow (seated or all fours).

f.yoga.warm04.intro.text: Standing side bend. Arms up, lean gently to one side, then the other.

f.yoga.warm05.intro.text: Mountain pose. Stand tall, feet hip-width, arms by your sides. Breathe.

f.yoga.main01.intro.text: Chair pose. Feet together or hip-width, sit back as if into a chair, arms up.

f.yoga.main01.cue2.text: Breathe out, sit a little lower

f.yoga.main02.intro.text: Warrior II (right). Feet wide, right toes out, bend the right knee over the ankle, arms out at shoulder height.

f.yoga.main03.intro.text: Warrior II (left). Same on the left side.

f.yoga.main04.intro.text: Tree pose (right, hold the chair). Stand on the left leg, right foot on your ankle or calf (never the knee). Hold a chair if you like.

f.yoga.main04.next.text: Next up: Tree pose (right, hold the chair).

f.yoga.main05.intro.text: Tree pose (left). Stand on the right leg, left foot on the ankle or calf.

f.yoga.main05.cue1.text: Find a spot to focus on

f.yoga.main06.intro.text: Chair pose flow. Inhale stand, exhale sit into chair pose. Hold the last one.

f.yoga.main07.intro.text: Downward dog (knees bent). From all fours, tuck the toes and lift the hips. Keep the knees bent and heels up.

f.yoga.main08.intro.text: Cat-cow flow. On all fours: inhale, lift the chest; exhale, round the back.

f.yoga.main09.intro.text: Triangle (right, short). Legs wide, reach forward over the right leg, hand to the shin or a chair, other arm up.

f.yoga.main11.intro.text: Mountain flow with arms. Stand tall. Inhale, arms overhead; exhale, hands to heart.

f.yoga.main11.next.text: Next up: Mountain flow with arms.

f.yoga.main12.intro.text: Chair pose hold. One more chair pose. Hold and breathe.

f.yoga.main12.cue2.text: Sink a little lower if you can

f.yoga.main13.intro.text: Warrior II flow (both sides). Warrior II right, straighten, warrior II left, with the breath.

f.yoga.main13.next.text: Next up: Warrior II flow (both sides).

f.yoga.main14.intro.text: Tree pose (right) again. Try lifting the arms if you feel steady.

f.yoga.cool01.intro.text: Seated forward fold. Sit, legs forward, hinge gently towards your toes.

f.yoga.cool02.intro.text: Gentle cat-cow. On all fours, slow cat-cow with long breaths.

f.yoga.cool03.intro.text: Supine twist. On your back, knees bent, let them drop to one side, then the other. Keep knees bent together and let them drop slowly side to side.

f.yoga.cool04.intro.text: Child's pose. Knees wide, sit back to your heels, arms forward.

f.yoga.cool05.intro.text: Relaxation. Lie or sit comfortably. Close your eyes. Breathe.

f.yoga.water.text: Water break. Grab a sip and shake out your arms.

f.yoga.cool.intro.text: Cool-down time. Seated forward fold. Sit, legs forward, hinge gently towards your toes.

m.pilates.intro.text: Welcome to 30 minutes of Pilates. I'm Reta. We'll work the core, the glutes and the back, nice and slow, on a towel or a carpet. Quality over quantity. Let's begin with some breathing.

m.pilates.outro.text: Lovely work. That's thirty minutes of Pilates done. Your core will thank you. Roll to your side, come up slowly, and have some water.

m.pilates.cool.text: Time for the cool-down. Lovely and slow, let's stretch it out.

m.pilates.hype.2.text: And breathe out as you move.

m.pilates.hype.3.text: Draw your belly button gently in.

m.pilates.hype.10.text: Keep breathing, don't hold your breath.

m.pilates.warm01.intro.text: Breathing and pelvic tilts. Lie on your back, knees bent. Gently tilt the pelvis with the breath. Keep your hips on the floor. Hips stay on the floor, just flatten and arch your lower back.

m.pilates.warm01.next.text: Next up: Breathing and pelvic tilts.

m.pilates.warm02.intro.text: Small bridges. Peel the hips up a little, then down. Slow.

m.pilates.warm03.intro.text: The hundred (knees bent, gentle). On your back, feet on the floor, pump the arms low. Breathe in for 5 pumps, out for 5. Head down is fine.

m.pilates.warm03.next.text: Next up: The hundred (knees bent, gentle).

m.pilates.warm04.intro.text: Spine stretch forward. Sit tall, legs apart, reach forward as you breathe out, roll up as you breathe in.

m.pilates.warm05.intro.text: Single leg stretch (beginner). On your back, hug one knee in while the other leg reaches long. Swap slowly. Head down is fine.

m.pilates.main01.intro.text: Glute bridge. Feet flat, squeeze and lift the hips, lower slowly.

m.pilates.main01.cue2.text: Lower one bone at a time

m.pilates.main02.intro.text: Side-lying leg lift (right). Lie on your left side, lift the top leg slowly, lower with control.

m.pilates.main04.intro.text: Clams (right). Lie on your side, knees bent, feet together, open the top knee. Keep your feet together, just open the top knee.

m.pilates.main05.intro.text: Clams (left). Other side. Keep your feet together, just open the top knee.

m.pilates.main06.intro.text: Bird dog. On all fours, reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back, return, swap.

m.pilates.main07.intro.text: Knee plank. Forearms down, knees down, straight line from head to knees.

m.pilates.main08.intro.text: Bridge with a hold. Lift, hold for 2, lower slowly.

m.pilates.main08.next.text: Next up: Bridge with a hold.

m.pilates.main09.intro.text: Leg lift (right) round 2. Smaller and slower than before.

m.pilates.main11.intro.text: Bird dog round 2. Pause for a breath at full reach.

m.pilates.main12.intro.text: Knee plank round 2. Head to knees in one line.

m.pilates.main13.intro.text: Clams (right) round 2. Pause at the top. Keep your feet together, just open the top knee.

m.pilates.main14.intro.text: Clams (left) round 2. Other side. Keep your feet together, just open the top knee.

m.pilates.main15.intro.text: Bridge pulses. Lift, then small pulses at the top, lower slowly.

m.pilates.cool01.intro.text: Spine stretch forward. Sit tall, legs apart, reach forward slowly and breathe.

m.pilates.cool02.intro.text: Lying spine twist. On your back, knees to one side, then the other.

m.pilates.cool03.intro.text: Hamstring stretch. On your back, one leg up, hold behind the thigh.

m.pilates.cool04.intro.text: Figure-4 stretch. Ankle on the opposite knee, gently draw in. Swap at 30 seconds.

m.pilates.cool05.intro.text: Breathe. Long slow breaths. Well done.

m.pilates.water.text: Water break. Grab a sip and shake out your arms.

m.pilates.cool.intro.text: Cool-down time. Spine stretch forward. Sit tall, legs apart, reach forward slowly and breathe.
